verdict.rationale: A national company registry could fairly be expected to document a path for non-resident founders, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes recording HTTP 403 walls at the robots.txt files of mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. No page content was fetched, so nothing shows eligibility rules, accepted foreign credentials or identifiers, or extra steps for non-residents.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
